answer: In a Proof of Agent network, we enforce hierarchical graph staking where each peer node occupies a distinct trust terrace. An unverified agent node resides on an isolated umber island until established nodes endorse it with collateral. Inter-agent endorsements require superlinear bonding curves: acquiring k identities scales attacker cost exponentially at O(2^k), ensuring Sybil flooding becomes computationally and economically prohibitive.
